paraphrase: Śiva says: when Kṛṣṇa Vāsudeva is born, I too shall appear as a brahmacārin: seeing an abandoned corpse in a cremation ground, I shall enter it by yogic power for the good of brahmins and be named Lakulī; the siddha-field called Kāyāvatāra will be famous as long as the earth lasts. There my sons will be the ascetics Kuśika, Garga, Mitra and Kauruṣya - brahmins learned in the Veda, celibate, who will attain the Māheśvara yoga and go to Rudra's world, whence return is hard. These are the Pāśupata siddhas, their bodies smeared with ash, devoted to the liṅga.
